instruction: Disable the system tray icon in VLC media player.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC preferences and identified the 'Use only one instance when started from file manager' checkbox but repeatedly failed to toggle it. Spent ~8 turns clicking the same wrong coordinates, then switched to Advanced Preferences, browsed Qt interface settings, searched for 'single', opened file manager and terminal, created a test video, but never successfully changed the setting.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC menus, navigate to Tools > Preferences, view Simple Preferences interface tab, switch to Advanced Preferences (All mode), navigate the Advanced Preferences tree, use terminal commands, open file browser dialogs
metadata.failure_analysis: Model identified the correct setting but failed to click the checkbox at the right coordinates. Spent too many turns retrying the same click position instead of adjusting. Later attempts to use Advanced Preferences and terminal commands also failed to change the config.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single checkbox toggle (disable systray icon) in the same VLC Preferences Interface tab that the model successfully navigated to. The systray checkbox is larger and more visually distinct.
metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC systray icon via Preferences. Evaluator kills VLC to force config save, then reads vlcrc to check qt-system-tray=0.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC configuration file (vlcrc) which contains the qt-system-tray setting.
Postconfig correctly kills VLC before reading config, forcing VLC to save its settings to vlcrc.
Metric function correctly parses vlcrc for 'qt-system-tray=' line and compares against expected value '0' (disabled).
Metric correctly handles the 'rule' expected type by directly accessing rule.get('expected_qt_system_tray') without incorrect nesting.
Default value of '1' (enabled) is correct for when the setting line is not present in vlcrc.
Single instruction requirement (disable systray icon) is fully covered by the single evaluator check.
Expected value '0' correctly represents the disabled state of the VLC system tray icon.
